title: File:E. Barrett Prettyman Federal Courthouse, DC.jpg
desc: The E. Barrett Prettyman Federal Courthouse located at 333 Constitution Avenue, NW in the Judiciary Square neighborhood of Washington, D.C. The building is listed on the National Register of Historic Places and is a contributing property to the Pennsylvania Avenue Historic District.
